subject.title: sec (7/9): redact declared scanner env values from error text

question: Should the project accept this member-authored change as the error-text privacy boundary for user-defined scanners while preserving raw JSON evidence unchanged?
rationale: The patch is technically focused and covered, but it changes the repository’s security and artifact-redaction boundary; member-authored items require explicit project judgment rather than automatic closure or merge.

options.title: Approve the redaction boundary
options.body: Merge the focused change and retain raw scanner JSON as unmodified evidence, with the related documentation work explaining that scanner authors must not emit secrets there.

options.title: Request a different artifact policy
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want raw evidence redaction or a broader artifact-sanitization policy, because that would require a distinct product and evidence-integrity decision.

recommendation.title: Approve the redaction boundary
recommendation.body: Merge the focused change and retain raw scanner JSON as unmodified evidence, with the related documentation work explaining that scanner authors must not emit secrets there.
